title: SSRF in preview endpoint
body: The API endpoint /api/preview?url= fetched user-supplied URLs. Sending http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ leaked AWS metadata. Fix: blocklist internal ranges.

title: IDOR in orders API
body: GET /api/v2/orders/{id} returned any order when the numeric id was substituted. Rails app.

title: Reflected XSS in search
body: The `q` parameter was rendered into a <script> tag without JS-string escaping. Payload: "; alert(1);//

title: pandoc RCE via lua filter
body: Uploaded filename controlled args to pandoc, enabling --lua-filter for arbitrary code execution.

title: ORDER BY SQLi
body: The sort_by parameter was concatenated into ORDER BY. Time-based blind extraction worked using pg_sleep. Django backend, PostgreSQL.
